about: Byte-exact examples for the ComMarker Omni X/Xe (BSL Executor7, USB 04B4:1004). Generated by omni-autofocus 1.0.0, whose encoders are verified on an Omni Xe 6W. Hex bytes are space-separated. 'frame' = what goes over USB; 'payload' = the command inside it.

framing.rule: FE FF | BE u16 total length | seq byte | status | payload padded to even, >= 12 | 00 | checksum = (b[6] + b[7] + b[N-4] + b[N-3]) & 0xFF
framing.data_port: OUT 0x02 / IN 0x84, seq byte 0x01..0x0F cycling; ack payload starts FA 01

height_sensor.AAC1 reply layout: reply payload: [0..1] echo AA C1, [2] bytes received, [4..] Modbus frame
height_sensor.decode: distance_mm = BE u32 of the 4 register bytes / 1000; 0x7FFFFFFF = no measurement

z_moves.axis: auxiliary axis 1, 800 pulses/mm, bRevRot = true, run 8 mm/s, accel 5 mm/s^2, start 0
z_moves.sequence: AA10 reset, 10 ms, AA10 run, list [03A0 move, 0A00 delay(1)] on the data port, poll AA05 until reply[12] bit0 set (or state <= 1), wait for the AA07 moving bit to clear, AA10 reset (or back to run if another program had the board in run state)

factory_calibration.focus_keys: lmcPars.params[parName=default].fBestFocalDistance (lens A) / fBestFocalDistance_B (lens B), in sensor mm
